candidates.change_summary: Remove the `if(intitalized)revert();` guard so SetMinSum can update MinSum even after initialization.
Replace the assignment `MinSum = _val;` with `MinSum = _val + 1;` so the stored MinSum differs from the original.
Invert the condition to `if(!intitalized)revert();` so SetMinSum reverts before initialization and never sets MinSum.
Change the assignment so MinSum is set to _val + 1 instead of _val.
Delete the assignment to MinSum so it remains 0 after the call.
Replace the assignment so MinSum is always set to 0 regardless of _val.
Delete the statement 'Log = LogFile(_log);' so Log is never assigned and the public getter returns the zero address.
Replace the assignment target with the zero address so the getter returns address(0) instead of the provided address.
Replace the assignment target with the contract's own address so the getter returns address(this) instead of the provided address.
Delete the 'if(intitalized)revert();' guard so a call after Initialized() still assigns Log, whereas in P it reverts and Log remains unchanged.
Delete the '_;' statement in the nonReentrant_ modifier so the SetLogFile function body never executes and Log stays unset.
